It is submitted that vide Annexure-P-2 petitioner had given reference to the Collector on 23.05.2023 (Annexure P-3) and when the Collector failed to take cognizance of that, then in terms of the Second Proviso of Section 64 of the Act of 2013, he had made application to the competent Sandeep Kumar Pathak vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119900461/
1 authority requesting it to direct the Collector to make the reference to it within a period of 30 days.
Thus, it is evident that, once Collector failed to take cognizance then, learned District Judge was obliged to call for the report and decide as to whether direction is maintainable or not, but could not have dismissed the application on technical grounds overlooking Annexure P-2.
Therefore, impugned order dated 28.09.2024 (Annexure P-1) having been passed without appreciation of the correct facts on record is set-aside.
